tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Get the current local time, date, time-zone abbreviation and UTC offset in one to 20 places. Optionally compare each place with a reference location. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a local time and optional date from one place to up to 20 destinations. Uses date-specific daylight-saving offsets and reports ambiguous local times. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

tools.name: find_meeting_times
tools.description: Find shared working-hour windows for two to 20 places. Customize local working hours and meeting duration, or search up to 14 additional days for the first suitable date. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

tools.name: get_timezone_facts
tools.description: Look up a place or time zone: standard and daylight-saving offsets, abbreviations, whether it observes DST, and transition dates for a selected year. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

tools.name: get_market_hours
tools.description: Get stock exchange, forex session, futures and crypto schedules, including the Asian, European and North American sessions. Shows current status and date-specific hours in your chosen time zone, accounting for supported holidays and early closes. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this ans

tools.name: get_market_overlap
tools.description: Find shared open windows across two or more supported markets or sessions for a selected date. Returns overlap times in your chosen time zone, accounting for daylight saving and supported market holidays. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.
